media.title: Magic’s Jalen Suggs teaches at camp in Turkey, connects with Sweeney as season nears
media.description: Magic guard Jalen Suggs talked about his time at the NBA’s Basketball Without Borders camp in Turkey, new coach Sean Sweeney and his busy summer.
